scenes.headline: GEMINI *KEEPS GOING*
scenes.say: Google says its new Gemini agent can keep working after you close your laptop.

scenes.heading: GIVE IT AN *OUTCOME*
scenes.say: Instead of just answering questions, it plans a job and uses your company's connected tools.

scenes.heading: ONE AGENT, *MANY JOBS*
scenes.say: The idea is one agent that researches, writes documents, creates media and runs code from the same conversation.

scenes.heading: CONTEXT THAT *STAYS*
scenes.say: It keeps context in the cloud and delegates pieces to specialized sub-agents, instead of restarting in every app.

scenes.heading: NOT JUST ONE *MODEL*
scenes.say: Google also describes automatic model choice, including Gemini and Claude, with controls for spending.

cons: Enterprise product, not a free Gmail upgrade
Company permissions and connectors still matter
pros: Persistent cloud work across connected tools
scenes.say: But this is enterprise AI, not a free upgrade to personal Gmail. Your company's permissions still decide what it can do.
Review what it produces before letting it act for you. What would you delegate first? Comment agent.

youtube.title: Gemini Agent Works After You Close Your Laptop
youtube.description:
Google's new Gemini agent, announced October 8, 2026 at Gemini at Work, is positioned as a persistent cloud agent for business work: questions, research, documents, media and code. Google describes memory, sub-agents, business connectors, model choice including Claude, and spending controls. This is Google Cloud enterprise functionality—not a promise of a free consumer Gemini/Gmail upgrade. Access depends on enterprise setup and permissions.
Source: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/welcome-to-gemini-at-work-2026
